results.summary_before: This design implements leaky-integrate-and-fire neurons and time-multiplexes them to realize multiple neurons from shared hardware. An input current is applied through the input pins, accumulates in a membrane potential that decays over time, and triggers a spike when the potential crosses a threshold. The membrane potential is exposed on the eight output pins and spike outputs appear on the bidirectional pins, so a higher input current should produce a higher firing rate. The documentation is brief and does not specify the number of neurons, the time-multiplexing scheme, or any silicon test results.
